faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About LingoArena
faq.subtitle: Learn all details about account access, test preparation methods, AI scoring systems, and student support policies.

item1.q: How closely do LingoArena mock exams resemble real exams?
item1.a: All TOEIC, IELTS, Aptis, and VSTEP test banks on LingoArena are continuously curated and updated according to the latest official formats from ETS, Cambridge, and the Ministry of Education. Exams feature accurate difficulty levels, authentic native speaker audios, and question distribution matching 100% of real test conditions.

item2.q: How accurate is the automated scoring and score prediction?
item2.a: The system utilizes standardized score conversion tables combined with adaptive ability algorithms. For Listening & Reading multiple-choice sections, accuracy is up to 95% compared to real exam scores. For Writing & Speaking, evaluations strictly follow official exam rubric criteria.

item3.q: How does the AI & Teacher Writing and Speaking evaluation work?
item3.a: Upon submitting your Writing essay or Speaking audio, the AI instantly scans for grammar, spelling, and vocabulary enhancements within 60 seconds. Subsequently, certified instructors (IELTS 8.0+ / TOEIC 950+) thoroughly evaluate each criterion with detailed feedback.

item4.q: How does the Spaced Repetition (SRS) algorithm help me remember?
item4.a: Based on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve and modern FSRS algorithms, the system calculates optimal review intervals just before your brain forgets a word. As a result, studying just 15-20 minutes daily guarantees long-term retention of thousands of essential words.

item5.q: Can I study across multiple devices (phone, laptop, tablet)?
item5.a: Yes. All your study progress, ongoing tests, flashcards, and mistake notebooks are synchronized in real time via your cloud account. You can take a mock test on your laptop and review flashcards on your mobile anytime.

item6.q: What is the refund and academic support policy?
item6.a: LingoArena offers a 100% refund guarantee within the first 7 days if you are not satisfied with the content or system quality. Technical and academic support is available 24/7 via live chat, hotline, and student community groups.
